notes: Option 3 is the most accurate and faithful: it correctly distinguishes the SDE/ODE relationship, refuses to overclaim that stochastic interpolants formally subsumes Lipman's FM objective, and cites real paper structure. Option 2 and 4 are strong but introduce the DSBM/Schrödinger-bridge axis well; Option 2 surfaces the genuine Shortcut-Models 'FM as special case of diffusion' clash, while Option 4 leans on an out-of-set source (AlphaFold Meets Flow Matching) hurting faithfulness. Option 1 commits the worst error: it presents a flat linear chain placing score-based diffusion at the BASE (subsumed by FM) which contradicts that diffusion and FM coincide at the deterministic limit, and it conflates SDE-based diffusion's position; its hierarchy 'FM ⊃ score-based diffusion' is a wrong subsumption claim.
